name: Button group
layerWhy: It joins a few buttons that act on one thing; it is still a single control, not a job.
promise: Its buttons act on the same thing, and with aria-pressed only one or some are on.
expectation: The buttons sit joined, under one name, so they read as one control.
evidence: The pressed button sits in the primary's quiet fill and is announced as pressed; the group has one name.
behaviour: Buttons are joined with shared outer corners.
With aria-pressed, each is a toggle.
context: Text alignment, a view switch, zoom: a few choices about one thing. Not for separate actions; those are a .pr-actions row.
relationships: One name for the group: "Text alignment".
Each button keeps its own verb.
failures: Never mixes unrelated actions in one group.
Never shows the pressed one by colour alone.
do: Keep it to a few buttons about one thing.
dont: A destructive action inside a group of safe ones.
